skills.name: adopt
skills.description: Brownfield audit — do existing artifacts actually work? Numbered migration plan. Unlike /project-stage-detect, checks compliance not existence.

skills.name: architecture-decision
skills.description: Create an ADR documenting a technical decision: context, alternatives considered, consequences.

skills.name: architecture-review
skills.description: Traceability matrix mapping GDD requirements to ADRs. Finds gaps, cross-ADR conflicts, engine compatibility. PASS/CONCERNS/NOT ASSESSED/FAIL.

skills.name: art-bible
skills.description: Author the Art Bible — visual identity gating asset production. Run before /map-systems.

skills.name: asset-audit
skills.description: Audit assets against naming conventions, file size budgets, format standards. Finds orphaned assets, missing references.

skills.name: asset-spec
skills.description: Per-asset visual specs plus AI generation prompts from GDDs and character profiles. After the art bible.

skills.name: balance-check
skills.description: Find balance outliers, broken progressions, degenerate strategies, economy imbalances in formulas and data. 'Check game balance'.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.description: Guides the user through finding and choosing a game concept. Use when the user wants game ideas, a new concept, a game jam idea, or to explore other directions, including dropping the current idea and starting over.

skills.name: bug-report
skills.description: Structured bug report from a description, or analyze code for potential bugs. Reproduction steps, severity.

skills.name: bug-triage
skills.description: Re-evaluate open bugs — priority vs severity, assign to sprints, surface systemic trends. Run when the count grows.

skills.name: changelog
skills.description: Auto-generate a changelog from git commits and sprint data. Internal and player-facing versions.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Architectural code review — coding standards, SOLID, testability, performance concerns.

skills.name: consistency-check
skills.description: Scan GDDs against the entity registry for cross-document conflicts. Grep-first approach targets conflicting sections, different stats.

skills.name: content-audit
skills.description: Audit GDD content counts against what's implemented — planned vs built.

skills.name: create-architecture
skills.description: Author the architecture blueprint before code is written. Validates decisions against the pinned engine, flags knowledge gaps.

skills.name: create-control-manifest
skills.description: Builds a short list of must-do and never-do coding rules per system from accepted ADRs. Use when the user wants programmer rules or a cheat sheet from the ADRs, or needs it regenerated after ADR changes.

skills.name: create-epics
skills.description: Turns the GDDs and architecture into epics, one per architectural module. Use when the user wants to break the game into epics or plan the work before writing stories. Not for splitting one epic into stories.

skills.name: create-stories
skills.description: Breaks one epic into implementable stories with acceptance criteria. Use when the user wants stories for an epic or the next batch of work to build. Not for turning the whole design into epics.

skills.name: day-one-patch
skills.description: Day-one launch patch — focused fix for known issues found after gold master. Mini-sprint with QA gate and rollback.

skills.name: design-review
skills.description: Reviews one design document for completeness, internal consistency, implementability, and design standards. Before handing to programmers.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description: Section-by-section GDD authoring for one system — walks through each required section, cross-references dependencies.

skills.name: dev-story
skills.description: Implements one story in code with tests, following its ADRs. Use when the user says to build, implement or start working on a story. Not for checking readiness beforehand or closing the story after.

skills.name: estimate
skills.description: Estimate task effort from complexity, dependencies, velocity, risk. Structured estimate with confidence levels.

skills.name: gate-check
skills.description: Ready to advance between development phases? PASS/CONCERNS/NOT ASSESSED/FAIL with blockers and required artifacts. 'Can we move to production?'

skills.name: help
skills.description: What should I do next? Use when stuck or you don't know what to do.

skills.name: hotfix
skills.description: Emergency fix bypassing normal sprint process — hotfix branch, approvals tracked, backport verified, full audit trail.

skills.name: launch-checklist
skills.description: Launch readiness across every department: code, content, store, marketing, community, infrastructure, legal, go/no-go sign-offs.

skills.name: localize
skills.description: Localization pipeline — find hardcoded strings, extract string tables, cultural review, VO, RTL, enforce string freeze.

skills.name: map-systems
skills.description: Decompose a concept into individual systems, map dependencies, prioritize design order, create the systems index.

skills.name: milestone-review
skills.description: Milestone progress review — completeness, quality metrics, risk, go/no-go recommendation. At checkpoints or before a deadline.

skills.name: onboard
skills.description: Onboarding doc for a new contributor or agent — project state, conventions, priorities relevant to the specified role.

skills.name: patch-notes
skills.description: Player-facing patch notes from git history and changelogs. Translates developer language into player communication.

skills.name: perf-profile
skills.description: Performance profiling — find bottlenecks, measure against budgets, produce ranked optimization recommendations.

skills.name: playtest-report
skills.description: Structured playtest report template, or turn existing playtest notes into structured feedback.

skills.name: project-stage-detect
skills.description: Analyze project state, detect stage, identify gaps, recommend next steps. 'Where are we in development?'

skills.name: propagate-design-change
skills.description: Finds architecture decisions (ADRs) made stale by a changed GDD and walks through resolving each. Use when the user changed a number or rule in a GDD and asks which ADRs or architecture decisions are now out of date.

skills.name: prototype
skills.description: Concept prototype before GDDs — throwaway HTML, Engine or Paper build, PROCEED/PIVOT/KILL/NOT ASSESSED. After /brainstorm and /setup-engine.

skills.name: qa-plan
skills.description: QA test plan for a sprint — classifies stories by Logic/Integration/Visual/UI, covers automated tests, manual cases, smoke scope.

skills.name: quick-design
skills.description: Lightweight spec for small changes — tuning adjustments, minor mechanics. Embeds directly into stories; skips full GDD.

skills.name: regression-suite
skills.description: Map test coverage to GDD critical paths, find fixed bugs lacking regression tests, flag drift from new features.

skills.name: release-checklist
skills.description: Pre-release checklist — build verification, certification requirements, store metadata, launch readiness.

skills.name: retrospective
skills.description: Sprint or milestone retrospective from completed work, velocity, blockers. Actionable insights for the next iteration.

skills.name: reverse-document
skills.description: Generate missing design or architecture docs from existing implementation — works backwards from code and prototypes.

skills.name: review-all-gdds
skills.description: Holistic cross-GDD review — contradictions between systems, dominant strategies, economic imbalance, cognitive overload, pillar drift.

skills.name: scope-check
skills.description: Scope creep check — current scope versus the original plan. Flags additions, quantifies bloat, recommends cuts. 'Any scope creep?'

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Security audit — save tampering, cheat vectors, network exploits, data exposure, input validation. Before public or multiplayer release.

skills.name: settings
skills.description: View or change project config — effective merged values, or set locally in project.local.yaml.

skills.name: setup-engine
skills.description: Configure engine and version. Pins it in CLAUDE.md; WebSearch fills reference docs when the version is beyond LLM training data.

skills.name: skill-improve
skills.description: Improve a skill via a test-fix-retest loop — static checks, targeted fixes, keep or revert on score change.

skills.name: skill-test
skills.description: Validate skill files for structural compliance and behavioral correctness. Four modes: static linter, spec, category rubric, audit.

skills.name: smoke-check
skills.description: Critical-path smoke gate before QA hand-off — runs the automated suite. A failed check means the build is not QA-ready.

skills.name: soak-test
skills.description: Soak test protocol for extended play — what to observe and log for slow leaks, fatigue, late-appearing edge cases.

skills.name: sprint-plan
skills.description: New or updated sprint plan from the current milestone, completed work, and available capacity.

skills.name: sprint-status
skills.description: Fast, concise sprint snapshot — burndown and emerging risks for situational awareness. 'How is the sprint going?'

skills.name: start
skills.description: Guides a first-time user through onboarding and picks the right workflow. Use when the user is new, just cloned or installed the studio, has no idea or engine yet, asks where to begin, or wants to bring in an existing game.

skills.name: story-done
skills.description: Closes a finished story: verifies each acceptance criterion, checks for design or ADR deviations and updates its status. Use when the user says a story is done, finished or ready to close.

skills.name: story-readiness
skills.description: Checks whether a story is ready to implement: clear acceptance criteria, no open questions, valid ADR and dependencies. Use when the user asks if a story, or the sprint's stories, are ready to start or build.

skills.name: team-audio
skills.description: Orchestrate the audio team — audio-director, sound-designer, technical-artist, gameplay-programmer — direction through implementation.

skills.name: team-combat
skills.description: Orchestrate the combat team — game-designer, gameplay-programmer, ai-programmer, technical-artist, sound-designer, qa-tester — design through implement and validate.

skills.name: team-level
skills.description: Orchestrate the level team — level-designer, narrative-director, world-builder, art-director, systems-designer, qa-tester — for complete area creation.

skills.name: team-live-ops
skills.description: Orchestrate the live-ops team — live-ops-designer, economy-designer, analytics-engineer, community-manager, writer — for a season or live event.

skills.name: team-narrative
skills.description: Orchestrate the narrative team — narrative-director, writer, world-builder, level-designer — for story, world lore, narrative-driven levels.

skills.name: team-polish
skills.description: Orchestrate the polish team — performance-analyst, technical-artist, sound-designer, qa-tester — to optimize and harden a feature or area.

skills.name: team-qa
skills.description: Orchestrate the QA team through a full testing cycle — qa-lead strategy and test plan, qa-tester case writing, execution, sign-off.

skills.name: team-release
skills.description: Orchestrate the release team — release-manager, qa-lead, devops-engineer, producer — to execute a release from candidate to deployment.

skills.name: team-ui
skills.description: Orchestrate the UI team through the UX pipeline — authoring, visual design, implementation, review, polish. Uses /ux-design, /ux-review, studio templates.

skills.name: tech-debt
skills.description: Track, categorize and prioritize technical debt across the codebase — scans for debt indicators, maintains a register.

skills.name: test-evidence-review
skills.description: Quality review of test files and evidence — goes beyond existence, evaluates assertion coverage. ADEQUATE/INCOMPLETE/MISSING/NOT ASSESSED per story.

skills.name: test-flakiness
skills.description: Find flaky tests from CI logs — aggregates pass rates, spots intermittent failures, recommends quarantine. After multiple runs.

skills.name: test-helpers
skills.description: Generate engine-specific test helper libraries — assertion utilities, factory functions, mocks in the engine's test folder. Reduces boilerplate.

skills.name: test-setup
skills.description: Scaffold the test framework and CI — tests/ directory, engine test runner, GitHub Actions workflow. Once, before the first sprint.

skills.name: ux-design
skills.description: Section-by-section UX spec authoring for a screen, flow or HUD. Reads the player journey to provide context; also project-wide accessibility.

skills.name: ux-review
skills.description: Validate a UX spec, HUD design or pattern library — accessibility, GDD alignment, readiness. APPROVED / NOT ASSESSED / NEEDS REVISION / MAJOR REVISION NEEDED.

skills.name: vertical-slice
skills.description: Pre-production validation — end-to-end build to confirm the full loop is achievable before committing to Production. After GDDs, architecture, UX specs.

transformations.new: No source preprocessing ran. Resolve needed project configuration explicitly

transformations.old: The user approves all architectural decisions and file changes.
transformations.new: Follow the current user's authorization for architectural decisions and file changes. Ask only for material choices or authorization that is missing.

transformations.old: The user approves all decisions and file changes.
transformations.new: Follow the current user's authorization for decisions and file changes. Ask only for material choices or authorization that is missing.

transformations.old: Do not use Write/Edit until the user has said yes. Ask by ending your turn with the draft and the question; if you are a subagent, whoever called you puts it to the user
transformations.new: Use file editing within the user's existing authorization. If authorization or a material choice is missing, present the draft and ask; a subagent asks through its caller

transformations.old:
Ask: "May I create the prototype directory at `prototypes/[concept-name]-concept/`
and begin implementation?"

If yes, create the directory. Every file must begin with:
transformations.new:
Create `prototypes/[concept-name]-concept/` within the currently authorized prototype task.
If implementation has not been authorized, ask before proceeding. Every file must begin with:

transformations.old:
Ask: "May I write this report to `prototypes/[concept-name]-concept/REPORT.md`
and add its row to `prototypes/index.md`?"

If yes, write the file.
transformations.new:
Within the currently authorized prototype task, write the report to
`prototypes/[concept-name]-concept/REPORT.md`. If report writing is outside the
authorized scope, obtain that authorization first.
